roadmap.heading: What's next
roadmap.hint: Vote on what you want first. You have three votes.

upload.a: Whatever you have: two to five years of financial statements, notes, MD&A, your current deck, projections, and the context of the transaction. Better sources, better work.

deliverables.a: Depending on the agreed scope: financial model, teaser, CIM, management presentation, and credit or equity decks. The team reviews every deliverable before uploading it to your Data Room. A service fee covers only the agreed preparation work: it does not guarantee financing, a sale, a buyer, a term sheet, or a closing.

room.q: How does your Data Room work?
room.a: Your documents live in folders, with versions and an activity log. A third party can only enter when the team issues their access for that Data Room, with a one-time code and an NDA when applicable. The site does not run a public catalog of deals: the team decides whom to contact and issues the access.

mcp.q: How do I connect my agent to my Data Room?
mcp.a: Copy your installation's MCP URL from the Team tab of your Data Room, under "Connect your agent". Add it as a remote MCP in your agent. In Claude, type /mcp and sign in with the same account you use to enter Sherlock. Your agent can read your Data Room summary, your documents, search, and the model, and upload documents to your room. It cannot see other companies.

contact.q: How do you contact the team?
contact.a: The box above reaches the team that runs this installation. You can also report a security issue there, without including passwords or confidential documents.

price.a: It depends on what your company needs and how much you use the room. We discuss it with you before starting. Write it in the box above.
